Report available monthly AWS emissions with source provenance

## Synopsis

```text
Query aws-ce historical carbon emissions for complete UTC months. End is exclusive. Totals sum returned records; missing data is not zero. Enable FINFOCUS_AWS_CARBON_ENABLED=true or configure plugins.aws-ce.carbon_enabled=true.
```

```text
finfocus carbon actual [flags]
```

## Options

```text
      --account strings     account IDs (comma-separated or repeated)
      --end string          exclusive UTC month boundary (YYYY-MM-DD; required)
  -h, --help[=true|false]   help for actual
      --method string       accounting method: market-based or location-based (default "market-based")
      --output string       output format: table or json (default "table")
      --region strings      AWS regions (comma-separated or repeated)
      --scope string        emissions scope: total, 1, 2 or 3 (default "total")
      --service strings     AWS service names (comma-separated or repeated)
      --start string        inclusive UTC month boundary (YYYY-MM-DD; required)
```
